groups.why_chosen: A page fault takes one of three shortcuts depending on cache and memory state, but every path converges on the same metadata-update and PTE-install finish, with only two steps needing locks.
groups.what_to_learn: Long bypass arrows over the top for fast paths; an icon + fill + legend marking the steps that need locks
